summary: Validated Dashboard RBAC (iter 80): GET /api/dashboard strips blocks for sections the user cannot view; UI reflows without empty gaps on desktop (1920) and mobile (390); permission changes applied without re-login (page reload / visibilitychange). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass. Frontend: verified restricted user shows only Eventi+Staff groups, then after DB membership change (grant sponsor, remove staff) the Commerciale block + Pipeline/Tipo charts appear and Staff disappears, sidebar updates accordingly. Direct access to /api/deals, /api/pipeline/attention, /api/companies returns 403 for restricted user. Collaboratore defaults correctly hide sponsor & pipeline. Dashboard-only user: no blocks present in response (frontend would show 'dashboard-empty').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py dashboard(): staff block fields (staff_totale, volontari_totali, confermati, da_confermare, rinunce) do NOT match the keys the frontend Dashboard.jsx reads (st.staff_confermati, st.volontari_confermati, st.da_riconfermare, st.volontari_richiesti/assegnati/mancanti/esubero). The frontend relies on _team_coverage() to supply those; verify consistency and consider aligning naming to avoid 'undefined' KPI cards. Not a blocker for RBAC but a UX inconsistency worth cleaning up.

Dashboard.jsx line 75 computes 'nothing' without considering S.ospitalita / S.briefing; empty-state message test case (dashboard-only perm) should still render because ev/crm/com/att/st are undefined - looks correct, but S.pipeline alone drives PipelineAttention visibility; good.
server.py: pipeline_chart and tipo_chart are always populated then popped if not can['sponsor'] - fine, but computation cost is small.
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted ephemeral TEST_ users (test_dash_user_*, test_collab_*, test_dashonly_*, test_dash_ui) in org 'org_qa_eventi' during fixtures; UI test user cleaned at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter80_dashboard_rbac.py (9 cases, all pass). Fixtures create TEST_ users directly in mongo with bcrypt password_hash and matching membership permissions, then clean up. Frontend route /app renders Dashboard; after login, user may be prompted for phone (set users.telefono directly in DB to bypass).
